rules.name: Missing authentication provider
rules.description: Sensitive endpoints or AI-enabled interactive flows must enforce a valid authentication session.

rules.name: Weak JWT signature validation
rules.description: JWT verifications must validate signatures and disallow the 'none' algorithm.

rules.name: Missing server-side resource authorization
rules.description: Resource mutations or lookups must verify ownership or explicit authorization role (IDOR/BOLA prevention).

rules.name: Missing tenant isolation
rules.description: Database operations in multi-tenant contexts must restrict query scope to the authenticated tenant/organization.

rules.name: Dynamic JavaScript code execution
rules.description: Using eval() or dynamic Function constructor invites remote code execution via untrusted strings.

rules.name: OS command injection
rules.description: System command execution functions must sanitize inputs or avoid shell interpretation.

rules.name: SQL Injection
rules.description: Unescaped variable interpolation in database queries bypassing query parameterization exposes the database.

rules.name: Rate limiting missing
rules.description: Sensitive endpoints like authentication, reset password, and heavy mutations require rate limiting controls.

rules.name: Mass assignment vulnerability
rules.description: Accepting unvalidated request parameters to update database objects invites parameter pollution and modification of system fields.
